req.title: Reject limit above cap
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when the limit parameter exceeds the maximum allowed.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should return an HTTP 422 status code when the 'limit' parameter exceeds the maximum allowed value. This ensures that the API enforces constraints on input parameters, preventing excessive data requests that could degrade performance or cause errors.

tests.name: test_limit_within_cap
preconditions: The database is pre-loaded with 20 tasks.
actions: Send a GET request to /tasks/ with limit=1000.
expected: The response contains a list of tasks.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)
response = client.get('/tasks/?limit=1000')
assert response.status_code == 200
assert isinstance(response.json(), list)
